g.text: a) insert LAMP PR-3 from the front side of the PCU internals.
b)attach the door latch spacer to the LAMP-PR3
from the back side of the PCU internals.
c) press the spacer and make sure it secures the door latch in its place.
a) 从PCU内部组件的正面插入LAMP PR-3。
b) 从PCU内部组件的背面将门锁垫片连接到LAMP-PR-3上。
c) 按压垫片，确保其将门锁固定到位。
